articleTitle: A Study on Weed Detection Based on Improved Yolo v5
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Currently, weeds in agricultural fields are one of the most common and serious biological threats to agricultural production. These weeds have a strong ability to reproduce, and they directly or indirectly affect crop yield and quality by competing with crops for nutrients, causing crop diseases, and attracting noxious insects, thus bringing great losses to agricultural production. In this aspect of weed detection Zhai et al. proposed a crop row recognition algorithm based on Census transform, and the experiment was only carried out on the cotton field video with simple background, and its correct rate was 92.58%. However, the algorithm requires a higher experimental environment because it did not go to the actual cotton field environment for detection.2021, Kaijing Li et al. proposed a YOLOv3 cotton field weed detection algorithm based on YOLOv3 for the complex cotton field environment in Xinjiang, and took the weeds near the cotton seedling during the moving process as the detection target, and trained the improved YOLOv3 network model through the improvement of the feature extraction network. Although there is some success, the accuracy of weed detection is still not high in complex situations. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a new model yolo v5-ct based on Yolo v5 by introducing the cbam module and the Transformer encoder module in the backbone feature extraction network, which improves the prominence of weeds in complex farmland backgrounds and strengthens the network's focus on weeds. The experimental results show that in relatively complex environments, the yolo v5-ct model effectively improves the problem of low weed recognition accuracy in complex environments.

articleTitle: Construction and Validation of Digital Twin Based Error Compensation Model for Intelligent Production Line
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This project is based on an industrial production line experimental platform, with production processes such as material identification, sorting, handling, and palletizing as research objects. A digital twin system based on the Internet of Things cloud platform is designed and developed to achieve physical and virtual information interaction, analyze twin data, solve the problem of physical positioning error compensation, and provide discrete digital twin technology support.

articleTitle: Improving Classroom Quality by Analyzing Student Behaviors Through Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper aims to enhance the efficiency of teaching and learning by leveraging computer vision technology for automated analysis of student behavior in the classroom. We propose a feature-enhanced method for recognizing student behavior, which integrates an Upsampling module (UPS) and a convolutional block layer (CBL) module into the YOLOv5 model. This innovative approach significantly improves the detection and feature extraction capabilities for student targets, effectively addressing challenges associated with small-sized targets and lowresolution images. Through algorithm optimization, it achieves a balance in sample diversity, enhancing the model's adaptability and generalizability in complex classroom environments. Building upon these technological advancements, we have developed a Classroom Student Posture Perception System (CSP2S). This system integrates functions for data collection, student behavior detection, and result visualization. The CSP2S operates in realtime by capturing and analyzing students’ behavioral dynamics while providing teachers with immediate feedback. Experimental results demonstrate that this system substantially reduces teachers’ workload in student assessment, offering significant potential to improve teaching effectiveness. These robust technical advancements provide strong support for future applications in real educational environments.

articleTitle: Research on Blended Learning Behavior Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The research on blended learning mainly focuses on hybrid teaching mode, flipped classroom and MOOC etc. Most of researches address online learning behaviors, instead of learning behaviors in hybrid learning environment. Research on blended learning behavior seeks to uncover some effective ways to harness the benefits of both face-to-face and online learning. This study collects the data from the teaching practice in a blended learning environment. A Spearman correlation analysis model is proposed to explore the impact of students' learning behavior on performance. Then, based on students' deep learning behavioral characteristics and attention mechanisms, a learning performance prediction model is constructed and applied to the experimental verification of the learning behavior data generated by the application of blended teaching mode in curriculum. Experimental results indicates that the proposed model can accurately predict students' performance based on their blended learning behaviors, thus providing instructors with countermeasures to improve students' learning behavior and further enhance the blended learning effect.

articleTitle: Research on Filter Model for Abnormal Force Signal of Fiber Optic in Distributed Temperature Measurement Host for Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The fiber optic temperature measurement host utilizes the principle of Raman scattering of light waves to monitor the temperature of the environment in real-time. Due to the extremely harsh working environment in mines, optical fibers are prone to compression deformation caused by foreign objects (falling coal blocks, mechanical equipment) after long-distance laying, leading to abnormal transmission of light waves and issuing invalid alarm signals. Invalid alarm signals can greatly interfere with the reliability and stability of coal mine safety monitoring systems, causing great difficulties to production operations. On the basis of in-depth analysis of the principle of Raman scattering of optical waves in temperature measurement hosts, this article proposes a segmented filtering model for fiber optic abnormal force signal temperature measurement band based on nonlinear polynomials. Through experimental analysis, it has been proven that the model can prepare to identify abnormal data generated by non environmental temperature effects in the optical path, greatly improving the reliability and effectiveness of the fiber optic temperature measurement host.

Author Keywords: euclidean distance, stokes light, anti Stokes light

articleTitle: Image Animation Based on Improved CycleGAN
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Aiming at texture blur and color distortion in the image generated by the original CycleGAN in the image animation task, this paper inserts self-attention mechanism into the skip connection of the generator to strengthen the acquisition of global information in the decoding part of the generator, and trains the model with the perceptual loss function Lpips to improve the sensitivity of content changes before and after image animation. In view of the network degradation, the feature converter is designed as the parallel residual block structure to improve the efficiency of feature conversion while reducing network depth. The experimental results show that compared with the original CycleGAN, CartoonGAN, and AnimeGAN, the improved CycleGAN not only has a better animation visual effect, but also outperforms the other three methods in the evaluation index FID.

articleTitle: Enhancing Online Teaching Effectiveness Through Hand-Raising Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: After the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic, online teaching has gradually emerged as an indispensable component of education. Despite its convenience, online education lacks the immediate interactive experience inherent in traditional classrooms. This paper presents a meticulously designed DS-YOLOv8 network model, specifically tailored for real-time recognition of students raising their hands under cameras. On our proprietary dataset, this network model exhibits exceptional accuracy in hand-raising detection, showcasing a 1.3% improvement in the AP50 index compared to the baseline YOLOv8 model. Our focus lies on the application of hand-raising detection within online classrooms with an objective to provide enhanced support for teachers by promptly identifying students raising their hands and thereby improving teaching efficiency while enriching the interactive experience of students in virtual learning environments.

articleTitle: Interactive Game Design and Development of Taishan Shadow Puppet Based on Gesture Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The traditional shadow puppet is a one-way communication medium with limited performance scope. This study designs and develops a somatosensory interactive system that applies virtual reality technology and somatosensory interactive technology to perform Taishan shadow puppet. The system combines differences between the shadow puppet and the user in the limb construction and movement characteristics, utilize an integrated action mapping method between the shadow puppet and the user with integrated action recognition and joint point mapping. Through the realization and application of this design, the multimedia art design and digital technology are closely integrated, so that the effect of digital shadow puppet in art, technology, operation and performance can be improved.

articleTitle: Enhancing Video Retrieval: A User Behavior-Based Query Expansion Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In this study, we propose a user behavior-based query optimization strategy to address the commonly observed suboptimal query performance and user experience in the field of video retrieval. This strategy primarily involves analyzing user behavioral data during the video retrieval process to expand query keywords, enhancing their relevance and diversity, thus optimizing search results. We achieved this by augmenting the original dataset to generate simulated user behavioral data and Ground Truth data. Subsequently, an automated query expansion algorithm effectively applied this data to video retrieval. Through experimental assessment on the video retrieval dataset (MSR- VTT), we validate the effectiveness of this method. The results demonstrate that this user behavior- driven query expansion approach significantly improves the accuracy of video retrieval and user satisfaction.

articleTitle: Guidance and Fault Recognition of Physical Experimental Operations Based on Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Physics experiments are an essential part of university physics courses since they cover a wide range of knowledge yet have limited class hours, making them challenging to learn. Students find it hard to receive individual guidance during the experimental process because of factors such as teaching resources. An improved convolutional neural network recognition method, incorporating short-term memory units based on existing theories, is proposed to identify the experimental images during the experimental operation, provide prompts to students based on the pattern of image changes, and automatically judge instrument malfunctions. Taking Newton's rings experiment as an example, a training dataset was created by matching image changes in experimental videos with the operation process. This dataset comprises 700, 000 experimental images taken from 1,400 standard experimental videos, with labels for seven different types of operational guidance and three various types of instrument malfunctions, achieving an accuracy of 95.2%. This method demonstrates a high recognition accuracy, which makes it easy to acquire training data and has great application prospects in solving experimental operation problems.

articleTitle: Fusion of OBE Framework and RF Algorithm in Enhancing the Teaching Evaluation System for Comprehensive Practical Course
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In response to the issues within the traditional teaching evaluation system for comprehensive practical courses, this study constructed a comprehensive teaching evaluation system based on the Outcome-Based Education (OBE) concept. Subsequently, the study introduced the Random Forest algorithm to conduct an in-depth analysis of the weightings of various indicators within the existing evaluation system. Leveraging the relative importance provided by the Random Forest method, it precisely optimized the weights assigned to the four key components. Ultimately, a rational evaluation system was successfully established, capable of accurately assessing students' learning outcomes and practical abilities in the comprehensive practical course, ensuring the accuracy and fairness of the evaluation.

articleTitle: A GA-SVM Model for Sleep/Wake Classification Using Single-Channel EEG Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The primary focus of this study is the development of an SVM-based method for classifying sleep/wake states using single-channel EEG signals. Through the optimization of the SVM model via a genetic algorithm (GA), optimal parameters (C=83.6932, gamma=0.0050) were obtained from the fitness curve. Building the GA-SVM model upon these parameters resulted in an impressive accuracy of 96.94% and a Cohen's kappa statistic of 0.9389, highlighting the model's exceptional classification performance. This model offers a reliable approach to precisely identify moments of sleep onset and awakening during subsequent sleep monitoring endeavors.

articleTitle: The Experiment and Study on the Correlation Between Facial Expression Analysis and Learning Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The learning state of students in the classroom is closely related to their learning outcomes. The integration of these two aspects enables instructors to promptly and accurately adjust their teaching methods, thereby improving the quality of instruction. This paper presents an experimental study that utilizes facial recognition technology to investigate the correlation between facial expressions and learning effectiveness. We designed a validation system to capture real-time facial expressions of learners during different time intervals and applied it in authentic classroom teaching activities. Through indepth analysis of a substantial volume of reliable data, we unveil the relationship between emotional experiences and expressions during the learning process and instructional content. The research findings offer valuable insights into comprehensively understanding the learning state of students and provide a basis for instructors to adapt their teaching approaches and enhance instructional quality.

articleTitle: Abnormal Traffic Detection Model Based on GAN for Information Security in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Network traffic detection systems play a critical role in the security of smart grid networks, as they are responsible for detecting and defending against various external attacks. Accurate network traffic anomaly detection is essential to ensure secure communication between power devices. However, traditional abnormal detection models often suffer from high false positive rates and inadequate detection performance. To address these issues, we propose an enhanced Bi-directional Generative Adversarial Network (BGAN) for network traffic anomaly detection. The BGAN model leverages the foundational framework of GAN to learn the distribution of complex traffic data. In this model, the discriminator incorporates a Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (BiGRU) network to capture the temporal correlations of sequential distributions. Additionally, we introduce an attention mechanism to enhance the model's ability to identify relevant information between input data and current output data, thereby improving overall detection performance. To evaluate the effectiveness of our proposed method, we conducted experiments using multiple datasets. The results demonstrate that our approach surpasses the performance of other compared traffic abnormal detection methods.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for PPG Motion Artifact Removal Based on GASF and cGAN
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel method for eliminating photoplethysmography (PPG) motion artifacts. Initially, 1-D PPG signals are transformed into 2-D images. Subsequently, employing a conditional generative adversarial network (cGAN), the original PPG signals are reconstructed from those affected by motion artifacts. The resulting images are then reverted back to 1-D time series. The proposed model exhibits a PSNR of 28.187 and SSIM of 0.959, indicating a remarkable similarity between the reconstructed PPG signals and the reference original PPG signal. Notably, the proposed approach cleans a noisy PPG signal segment in just 0.13 seconds, highlighting its potential as a viable real-time solution for removing motion artifacts from biomedical signals.

articleTitle: New Upper Bounds of Cumulative Coherence for l1-2-Minimization in Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
