articleTitle: An Enhanced Short Video Caching Strategy Based on User Behaviour and Time Factors
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Caching plays a crucial role in network systems, and an appropriate caching strategy can effectively reduce network load and enhance user experience during video browsing. The proliferation and development of smartphones have led to a surge in global mobile data traffic. This paper targets the viewing characteristics of short video platform users, and proposes two adaptive video cache update mechanisms, TelLRU and TelLRU(sigmoid), aiming to achieve optimal performance by dynamically adjusting the cache video block size according to the video playback duration. This strategy is an improvement on the LRU cache replacement algorithm, adding a section of the video file of a new request to the cache. During video playback, the length of the video block changes dynamically according to a specific algorithm, and the LRU replacement strategy replaces the least recently used video block. Experimental results show that this strategy can significantly improve the cache hit rate of mobile video-on-demand platforms, reducing delay time and delay proportion.

articleTitle: Research on early warning of abnormal learning behavior based on educational big data mining
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the accelerating process of digitization and informatization in the field of education, the application of data mining technology in the field of education has received more and more attention. This paper proposes a monitoring and early warning scheme for abnormal behavior of course learning based on data mining technology, including the collection, cleaning, and analysis of students' learning behavior data, as well as the establishment of early warning models and the implementation of early warning strategies. At the same time, this paper also discusses the organic combination of online and offline teaching, as well as the reflection on the practice of curriculum teaching. By combining online and offline resources, it designs diversified learning tasks and evaluation methods to promote students' participation and independent learning and improve the effectiveness of curriculum teaching and students' enthusiasm for learning.

articleTitle: Online Q&A for Machine Learning Courses Based on Formula Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Mathematical formulas are ubiquitous in courses such as Machine Learning. Understanding these formulas is the primary challenge for studying of students. If a searchable knowledge base can be built for these formulas, it will help students learn. Accurate identification of these formulas is an important step in building and querying the knowledge base. However, mathematical formulas have complex two-dimensional and nested structures, which makes them inconvenient to search like ordinary text. This paper employs Faster R-CNN to detect regions containing mathematical formulas and improves its backbone network, anchor box dimensions, and pre-training network to make it more accurate and efficient in identifing these formulas. Furthermore, in order to enhance the features and meaningful representation of mathematical formulas in the input image, we introduce the distance transformation. Finally, comparative experiments were conducted on the publicly dataset GTDB. Our proposed approach achieved recognition rates of 91.22% and 85.74% for isolated and hybrid formulas detection.

articleTitle: A Latent Dirichlet Allocation-Based Model for Mining Texts in China's Intelligent Elderly Care Policy
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: A multitude of information embedded in policy texts reflects the government's policy inclinations, objectives, and impacts. This paper conducts text mining from two dimensions: the policy instruments and implementation topics, establishing a policy text mining model based on LDA, offering a novel approach to policy text mining. By delving into 133 Chinese policy texts on Intelligent Elderly Care, the structural implementation of policy instruments and 10 implementation topics were unearthed. Using multinomial logistic regression, the implementation preferences for different topics' policy instruments were determined, providing insights for stakeholders in the Intelligent Elderly Care policy industry.

articleTitle: Research on Non-Invasive DataStandardization Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This work presents the design and implementation of a non-invasive data standardization system, encompassing the technical implementation scheme, data standardization process, and system data structure design. Additionally, the work provides an analysis of the applicable scenarios and application methods of the system. Currently, this system has been deployed as a subsystem of China Mobile's Smart Campus BigData Platform and has played a pivotal role in several key projects, supporting data governance and data mining efforts within the Big Data Platform.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Yolov5 Algorithm in Quadcopter UAV Target Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: When realizing the identification of ground targets based on quadcopter UAV, there are problems such as small target, occlusion and background interference, which lead to low detection accuracy, complex low-altitude tracking environment and changeable situation, which lead to easy loss of tracking. Improved Yolov5 target detection algorithm is proposed to ensure the recognition performance and improve the detection accuracy in this paper. Ensuring recognition performance and improving detection and recognition accuracy provides technical support for UAV to independently plan routes for target tracking in complex environments.

articleTitle: Enhancing Programming Course Quality through Human Posture Recognition and Screen Content Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The evaluation of programming course instruction is a key component of educational management. However, relying solely on supervising teachers for assessment poses challenges in comprehensive evaluation and providing feedback on students' classroom learning status. Additionally, a significant amount of monitoring video data from programming courses in Chinese universities remains underutilized. To address these challenges, this paper combines traditional educational management with artificial intelligence and proposes an intelligent algorithm for detecting students' learning status in programming courses. We first establish a dual YOLO network model to analyze students' postures and screen content in programming classroom monitoring videos, thereby identifying their behaviors. Subsequently, we develop a Programming Classroom Student Behavior Recognition System (PCSBS) that integrates data collection, student behavior detection, and result visualization functionalities. Experimental results demonstrate that the system can accurately provide feedback on students' programming course learning status, offering graded results that assist supervising teachers in their classroom instructional evaluation tasks to enhance educational management efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on the Cultivation of Students' Software Application and Independent Innovation Ability Under Project-Driven Mode in the Whole Life Cycle of Teaching
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In order to improve the quality of higher education personnel training, students' initiative should be fully brought into play on the basis of traditional teaching methods, and a systematic and comprehensive knowledge system should be constructed to associate similar knowledge points and construct a knowledge cloud. Then, students can internalize and selfconstruct what they have learned, and change knowledge into ability and quality. Take the joint learning and project-driven training of “Automobile Theory”, “Automobile Innovative Design” and “Engine Principle” in the course group of Vehicle engineering as an example. The interactive content of project and course learning and the outcomes of students' learning and growth are introduced. In the process of project research, Statistical Package for Social Sciences (SPSS) analysis and Matlab software were used to analyze some survey parameters and do the Back-Propagation (BP) neural network training and gain the relationships of the fuel consumption, comfort and other features of the automobile. Students also have a new understanding of relevant curriculum knowledge through the full analysis and application of data. At the same time, the project has gained a lot in the special research, paper publication and patent application of university-level university students. This kind of teaching and research topic deserves further promotion.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Self-Built Plagiarism Detection System for University Academic Integrity
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of a self-built plagiarism detection system for academic integrity in universities. Natural language processing techniques are incorporated into the system for text comparison using the cosine similarity algorithm. The results of the experiments indicate that the system detects plagiarism accurately and efficiently in students' reports and papers. Key components of the system include text preprocessing, similarity calculation, and a userfriendly interface. It is evident from the findings that self-built plagiarism detection systems are essential for maintaining academic integrity. The system provides universities with an effective means of maintaining academic integrity and ensuring originality.

articleTitle: The FPGA Pocket Experimental Plate Design and Application in Experiment Teaching
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of the level of science and technology, the requirement of FPGA teaching innovation and teaching quality improvement is increasing day by day. In the past, there were obvious shortcomings in the FPGA teaching model, such as old experimental equipment and large space limitations, which led to students needing to go to the laboratory frequently and waste time, and also caused the teacher to supervise the efficiency of students all the time, and could not give targeted suggestions for individual problems. To solve this problem, an ALTERA-EP1C3 portable test board with small size, low price and rich functions is designed in this paper. Based on this pocket experiment board, the appropriate teaching plan and teaching mode are proposed, so that students can freely conduct experimental exploration and teachers can put forward targeted suggestions on students' individual problems, which greatly improves the efficiency of both sides and is conducive to improving the breadth and depth of FPGA teaching, hoping to help teaching reform.

articleTitle: Agile Design of Innovation and Entrepreneurship System of College Students Based on Micro-service Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The research is based on the perspective of microservice architecture construction, and taking an innovation and entrepreneurship system of college students as an example. The study is devoted to completing Agile development process for this system with technology of micro-service architecture and Scrum model, and describes a feasible process of Agile design and implementation for the first Sprint version. Feedback on application for college students of software engineering major in experimental university is positively, which is an effective approach for promoting their innovative and pioneering abilities.

articleTitle: TISAP: Teaching Interface for “Signal Analysis and Processing” Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The signal analysis and processing course holds significant importance in the field of communication engineering. It is known for its extensive content and the challenges it presents in terms of comprehension. Consequently, there is an urgent need to explore novel teaching techniques that can enhance the effectiveness of teaching. To address this concern, TISAP, a new Teaching Interface for the course “Signal Analysis and Processing” based on MATLAB is proposed. The interface encompasses the fundamental concepts of the course and facilitates the visual representation of these concepts to students via an interactive interface. Additionally, it enhances the integration of theoretical concepts with practical programming skills by showing practical application cases. Following the use of this instructional platform, there was a notable augmentation in students' enthusiasm for learning, accompanied by enhanced cognitive processes and comprehension of the course.

articleTitle: Application of Digital Twin Technology in the Teaching of Engineering Drawing Course
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: As an advanced technology that integrates virtuality and reality, digital twin technology has shown a wide range of application prospects in various fields. This paper aims to explore the potential application of digital twin technology in the teaching of engineering drawing courses, to improve students' theoretical knowledge and practical ability. By combining digital twin technology with traditional engineering drawing teaching, students can carry out practical operations and simulations in a virtual environment to better understand and apply drawing concepts and principles. Besides, taking the assembly drawing of thread connection as an actual teaching case, the specific application of digital twin technology in theoretical and experimental teaching is explained, respectively. The results show that digital twin technology is conducive to improving students' interest in engineering drawing courses and training students' spatial imagination ability, which is of great significance to reforming drawing courses.

articleTitle: Application of a Dynamic Model for Student Recognition Based on Graph Attention Neural Network in Education
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In student education, teaching students according to their aptitude is an important part of implementing the fundamental task of cultivating morality and talent. However, universities currently face problems such as single identification methods, late discovery, and single data objects when depicting different types of students. This article proposes a solution to these problems by constructing a student social network through course selection data, class information, dormitory information, one card consumption, and access control data. The student feature embeddings are constructed in databases such as school entry and exit information, and attention neural networks are trained using the results of heart-to-heart conversations as student labels. This approach effectively improves the recognition rate of different types of students, especially for special students, in a timely and accurate manner, to assist teachers in teaching students according to their aptitude.

articleTitle: The Teaching Application of Deep Learning in Diagnosis of Automobile Abnormal Sound Faults
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Traditional manual diagnosis methods are often used in teaching and practice of vehicle faults diagnosis. It leads to low accuracy in detecting abnormal sound in vehicles and low student interest in learning. With the development of deep learning and artificial intelligence technology, using the above methods to identify the types of abnormal sound of vehicles can effectively improve the accuracy of vehicle faults diagnosis and achieve the purpose of improving the teaching quality of faults diagnosis. In this paper, microphone array is used to achieve abnormal sound location, and transfer learning for the Audio domain is used to classify and diagnose abnormal sound. From the experimental results, transfer learning has demonstrated significant feasibility and high accuracy in diagnosing vehicle abnormal sound faults. It provides innovative directions and has a certain leading role in the teaching and practice of vehicle fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on Named Entity Recognition Method Based on Option Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The educational knowledge graph plays an important role in smart education, and how to effectively recognize named entities is the first important part of constructing educational knowledge graph. This study proposes a named entity recognition model based on Option hierarchical reinforcement learning to realize named entity recognition for domain-specific knowledge in higher education. The innovations of this study are reflected in the following two aspects: First, based on the domain knowledge characteristics, a multi-head attention mechanism based on weighted combinatorial similarity is designed to realize further screening of information. Second, the concept of hierarchical reinforcement learning is introduced into the naming recognition model, and the Option-Critic framework is improved and applied to named entity recognition to improve the accuracy of naming recognition. In order to verify that the model proposed in this study is valid, Computer Networks, a core foundation course for university computer science majors, is used as an example. Comparison experiments are conducted using the traditional Bert-BiLSTM-CRF model and the present model, and the experiments prove that the model proposed in this study is feasible and effective.

Author Keywords: multi-head attention mechanism based on weighted combinatorial similarity

articleTitle: Behavior Recognition of Teachers and Students in the Smart Classroom Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the development of the concept of education evaluation, it is a key issue to effectively and accurately detect and analyze the behavior categories of teachers and students in the classroom. Firstly, this paper investigates the common behavior categories of students and teachers in the classroom. And on this basis, we sorts out 7 major behavior categories that students are usually involved in the classroom. Then, computer vision and artificial intelligence techniques are introduced to design an intelligent classroom behavior recognition system for teachers and students. Finally, the system is applied to various types of datasets for testing to verify the effectiveness of the system. Based on computer vision and artificial intelligence technology, the detection and analysis of students learning behavior in classroom can provide timely data support for teachers to grasp students' classroom learning status, optimize teaching design and implementation.

articleTitle: Development of Experimental Teaching Device for System Identification Based on Physical White Box
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In order to lower the entry barrier to system identification learning, a set of experimental teaching device was developed, including a ‘white box’ whose internal structure comprised of first-order and second-order circuits with unknown parameters, a waveform measurement tool based on STM32F103 microcontroller, and host computer software used for waveform data analysis. The experiment content based on the step response method has also been designed. The test results indicate that the circuit design of the ‘white box’ is correct, and the waveform measurement tool is designed reasonably and measured accurately, making it suitable for system identification experimental teaching.

articleTitle: Research on Tobacco Foreign Object Detection Based on Deep Learning of Texture Features
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The content of foreign objects in tobacco directly affects the sensory quality of cigarette products. As tobacco leaves are agricultural products, it is inevitable that some foreign objects are mixed in during the picking, transportation, and other processes. In the process of cigarette manufacturing, We need to detect foreign objects from the fast-moving production line in time to prevent them from flowing into the next process. Considering the real-time property of detection and the unique texture characteristics of tobacco leaves, this paper proposes a tobacco foreign object detection method based on texture features and YOLO v8 model, using single-channel grayscale images. The experimental results show that the mAP–0.5 of the algorithm in this paper is 98.5%; when the confidence is 0.967, the detection precision is 100%. The average prediction time for each image is 27.1 ms, which meets the real-time requirement. This proposed scheme has the advantages of fast foreign object detection speed, low cost, and easy deployment, and has good promotional value.

articleTitle: Research on the Guidance of Emotion Generation Based on Adversarial Networks on the Positive Mentality of College Students
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In recent years, with the increasing pressure of college students' study and life scientific research, the anxiety about the future and the phenomenon of psychological and behavioral problems are also increasing, and less smiling expression appears on students' faces. Research shows that smiling expression has a great guiding effect on students' relieving pressure. Therefore, the accurate reproduction of students' smiling faces is of great significance to help solve students' mental health problems, and has a wide application prospect. Based on this phenomenon, this paper uses an improved GANimation network to generate smiley faces to help students regain a positive attitude. The network mainly adds original image training to the generator training process, increases cyclic consistency loss on the basis of generating adversarial networks, and improves by replacing ordinary convolution with deep separable convolution. 200,000 preprocessed facial expressions in celebA dataset were selected for training. The test results show that, under the premise that the model is lower than the same type network in terms of computation and parameters, the smiling expression images have the characteristics of high resolution, high background retention, rich texture, and high restoration degree. Therefore, it can be concluded that: The trained smile expression can guide students to have a positive mental state to deal with the stress and anxiety of life.

articleTitle: Research on the Learning Evaluation System of Vocational Education Driven by Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Benefiting from Education Informatization 2.0, the field of vocational education has generated a large amount of data, which has changed the way of “teaching” and “learning”. Today, the entire learning process can be identified and recorded. In order to solve the problems existing in the current digital teaching platform of vocational colleges, this study started from the three dimensions of learning attitude, learning process and learning effect, tracked students' learning situation, and constructed a teaching evaluation system. Use learning big data to diagnose problems, carry out teaching intervention, provide precise and personalized educational support, highlight the characteristics of learning management in the big data era, and promote the development of smart vocational education learning.

articleTitle: Big Data on the Teaching Effectiveness of Civics Courses in Universities Based on Self-Coding Multilayer Perceptron Model Comprehensive Evaluation Research
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Practice education is an important part of talent training. In the new era, it is in line with the social development trend to promote practical education in universities in conjunction with the “Internet+” strategy. In this study, a total of 1350 social practice teams from 23 universities were analysed using an autocoder. Forty-eight indicators were recoded to obtain new eight dimensional reconstructed indicators. These new metrics were then fed into a multi-layer perceptron model to generate predictive values for performance evaluation. Finally, an error analysis of the four different algorithms was performed and confirmed that the AE_MLP algorithm used in this study had the lowest error effect. The model now has a recognition error of only 0.1267, which is a 60.21% improvement in accuracy compared to the traditional GLM algorithm, and can to some extent assist university cognitive workers in making certain decisions about the effectiveness of social practice.

articleTitle: Research on Mental Health of College Students Based on Branch and Bound Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Mental health is of great significance in college students, but how to effectively evaluate and intervene in college students' mental health is still a challenge. The aim of this study is to explore a method based on branch and bound algorithm to assist college students in mental health assessment and intervention decision-making. Firstly, we introduce the basic principle and application background of branch and bound algorithm. Then, we describe in detail the steps and processes of applying branch and bound algorithm in the study of college students' mental health. We also use the data of the empirical study to demonstrate the application effect of branch and bound algorithm in the mental health assessment of college students. Finally, we discuss the limitations of branch and bound algorithm in the study of college students' mental health, and propose the direction of future research.

articleTitle: Multi-Exposure Image Fusion via Attention Guided Multi-Scale Detail Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Multi-exposure image fusion (MEF) is to combine several images of different exposures into one image with moderate exposure and rich detail. However, many existing MEF methods may lose some details in the feature extraction process. How to extract deeper and richer details has always been a hot topic in MEF research. This article proposes an attention oriented multi-scale detail enhancement MEF network. The network consists of three modules, and the feature extraction module is used to extract deeper and richer detailed features guided by attention. The detail enhancement module further captures more texture details and color information, enhancing image details. The fusion network module is used to regenerate the fused image, which can effectively prevent the occurrence of double shadows and the loss of important information. In addition, the multi-scale feature extraction strategy supplements features of different scales, providing fine details and contextual features. Our method achieves better performance in enriching image details compared to other classic MEF methods through subjective perception and objective indicators MEF-SSIM and PSNR.

articleTitle: Image Inpainting Model in Man-Made Scenes Based on Structural Prior and Content Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Inpainting a large number of free form missing areas in man-made scene images is a challenging task. Although current methods have made significant progress in using Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), they still produce distorted structures and blurred textures when dealing with large missing areas. The main challenge lies in inferring image content from distant contextual information and synthesizing finegrained textures near large missing areas. To address these issues, this paper proposes a new image inpainting network, namely the Coherent Semantic Structure Inpainting Network. Specifically, in the first stage, the learning generator is used to recover damaged image structures, restore edges, lines, and knots to make reliable predictions of the entire image structure. At the same time, the second stage of the generator performs coherent semantic content reconstruction, learning to repair missing areas by borrowing feature blocks from known regions through joint training with auxiliary context recovery tasks. The test results on the places2 dataset show that compared with mainstream algorithms, our method achieves an average SSIM of 0.914 and an average PSNR of 27.513dB when the mask rate is 40%. It can generate images with rich textures and reasonable structures, and the image quality is superior to comparison algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Gesture Recognition Technology Controlled by sEMG in the Space Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the mission phase of China's space laboratory and space station, the flight control and space experiment tasks of astronauts and space experimenters are becoming more and more burdensome, and improving the efficiency of human-computer interaction of on-orbit personnel and reducing the operational burden of on-orbit personnel in carrying out their tasks are one of the important means of safeguarding the burdensome space tasks, and at the same time, natural and efficient human-computer interaction means are also the important auxiliary technology of ground simulation training for astronauts and space experimenters. At the same time, natural and efficient human-computer interaction is also an important auxiliary technology for the ground simulation training of astronauts and space experimenters. In this paper, we propose a space robot research based on surface electromyographic signal (sEMG) EMG signal control, through the acquisition, feature extraction, and classification research of surface EMG signals in the space environment, to explore the use of surface EMG signals of the corresponding region for gesture action pattern recognition, to obtain accurate control signals, and then to control the action actuators to carry out different actions, to complete the control of space robots, and The sEMG signals used for human-robot interaction technology can be multiplexed simultaneously as a source of medical insurance and medical monitoring signals, which effectively improves the utilization efficiency of space safeguard devices. This technology is characterized by naturalness and high efficiency, which is of exploratory significance for improving the operation efficiency of on-orbit personnel, taking into account the application of on-orbit personnel's medical insurance and medical monitoring, and guaranteeing the successful completion of space experiment tasks.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Visual Attention Cascaded Network for Multi-Focus Image Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Multi-Focus Image Fusion is the process of extracting focus areas from different images to form a fully focused fusion image. However, the defocus spread effect (DSE) in the region near the image focus/defocus boundary (FDB) will result in an unclear fusion effect in the FDB. This paper proposes a cascaded convolutional network based on residual multi-scale and attention mechanism and name it MSAC-Net. Specifically, MSAC-Net consists of two cascading subnets. The first subnet is used to generate the decision map that labels the FDB and is responsible for the initial fusion of the images. The second subnet refines the fusion results of the FDB according to the decision making. This paper introduces multi-scale feature extraction unit and attention mechanism unit in the first subnet, aiming at extracting multi-level features from different scales of space and fusing them in order to mine more spatial information and help the network to localize the FDB. The experimental results illustrate that the proposed method outperforms several existing multi-focus image fusion methods in terms of subjective visual effects and objective quality metrics.

articleTitle: Fatigue Status Detection Method of Electric Power Workers Based on Multiple Physiological Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Fatigue is a feeling of physical and mental tiredness caused by long hours of work, study, or physical activity. Fatigue affects thinking, decision-making and creativity, reducing productivity and performance. Fatigue also increases the risk of errors and accidents. In order to further perceive the fatigue status of power workers and avoid serious problems caused by fatigue. We comprehensively considered the characteristics of various physiological signals, finally selected electroencephalogram signals and electrooculogram signals, and proposed a fatigue state detection method based on multiple physiological signals through data fusion and balancing processing. Experimental results show that this method can allow multiple physiological signals to work together, effectively identify fatigue states, and have higher accuracy and recall rates than previous studies in fatigue detection tasks.

articleTitle: Research on International Chinese Education Led by Information Technology in the Post-Epidemic Era
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper takes the teaching practice process of international Chinese education courses in universities as the research object and explores new modes, means, and methods of international Chinese education in the post-epidemic era, aiming to establish a new type of classroom and teaching resources and methods that can guide numerous aspects of teaching and learning. Through practical research, this paper finds that under the new situation of information globalization and in the postpost-epidemic period, international Chinese education has the trend of online and offline blended teaching, and the new online teaching mode can effectively assist in offline teaching owing to the variety of informatization means and new artificial intelligence technology. At the same time, the high cognitive level and comprehension of Chinese learners in colleges and universities is conducive to the teaching of language application through the introduction of appropriate linguistic theoretical knowledge.

articleTitle: Liver Image Segmentation Method Based on TransUNet and Axial Attention
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the task of liver image segmentation, due to the complex edges and internal structure of liver images, as well as the presence of adjacent organs, conventional medical image segmentation networks have exhibited local deficiencies in handling long-range dependencies and multi-scale information. These deficiencies may impact the accuracy of liver segmentation models. To address the small receptive fields of convolutional operations in previous medical image segmentation models and the information loss issue in the skip connections of the TransUNet model, this paper introduces Axial Attention and residual connections into the skip connections of the TransUNet model. Axial Attention weights the importance of different dimensions, better capturing and enhancing liver edges and other targets. Additionally, the use of residual connections effectively alleviates gradient vanishing and information loss issues. Experimental results demonstrate that the improved TransUNet model proposed in this paper achieves dice and IoU evaluation metrics of 97.2% and 94.0%, respectively, on the LiTS17 dataset, representing an improvement of 1.6 percentage points and 2.1 percentage points in Dice and IoU metrics, respectively, compared to the original TransUNet model. Its liver segmentation performance surpasses that of the original TransUNet model, and the improved TransUNet model can more accurately identify liver edges, enhancing feature representation and information flow, and providing more refined segmentation results.

articleTitle: Establishment and Application of BP neural network model for Quality Assessment of Innovation and Entrepreneurship Education in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The quality evaluation of innovation and entrepreneurship education is the monitoring and feedback of innovation and entrepreneurship education in colleges and universities, which helps to promote the deepening of innovation and entrepreneurship education reform and improve the level of innovation and entrepreneurship education. Aiming at the deficiency of traditional innovation and entrepreneurship education quality evaluation technology, the BP neural network was applied to the quality evaluation of innovation and entrepreneurship education in colleges and universities. Firstly, the traditional BP neural network was introduced, and the BP neural network adaptive algorithm was proposed. Then, the quality evaluation index system for innovation and entrepreneurship education in colleges and universities was designed, and the evaluation level and evaluation index assignment method for innovation and entrepreneurship education quality in colleges and universities were determined. Finally, based on the BP neural network adaptive algorithm, the BP neural network model for the quality evaluation of innovation and entrepreneurship education in universities was established. At the end of the paper, an empirical study was carried out, and the results show that the BP neural network model for the quality evaluation of innovation and entrepreneurship education in colleges and universities has strong feasibility and effectiveness, which provides a new idea and a new way for the quality evaluation of innovation and entrepreneurship education in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: A Teaching Figure Classification Based on the Fusion of Multiple Modals
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Deep learning-based classification methods can help the teaching system automatically collect figure samples while the samples from different sources cause the difficulty of the classification. To solve this problem, we use multiple models to increase the accuracy of the classification. In more details, we pretrain the deep learning models on some public datasets. Then, we continuously train these models on teaching figure datasets. On a figure sample, we firstly classify the dataset that may contain this sample. After we predicted the dataset, we apply a weighted fusion method to classify the label of this sample. As the experimental results shows, our methods can achieve higher accuracy than the existing ones.

articleTitle: A Bibliometric Review of the Teaching Personal and Social Responsibility Model in Physical Education
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper synthesizes research on the Teaching Personal and Social Responsibility (TPSR) model and provides guidance on what TPSR research can do for students' personal character development. To this end, an innovative approach combining bibliometrics and literature review was used. The bibliometric data of 124 suspicion avoidance articles were analyzed and a knowledge map was constructed. The results of the bibliometric analysis showed that the model of teaching personality and responsibility was identified as the main central theme in physical education for the development of teachers' teaching competencies and students' personal cognitive development, and the development of social responsibility. In addition, the main authors, countries, journals, literature and cocitation information of the current research were sorted and knowledge was mapped. For researchers, it provides ideas for the way forward in the field based on the current state of research. For learners, it provides a systematic source of information on how TPSR promotes social responsibility efforts.

Author Keywords: teaching personal and social responsibility model

articleTitle: Double-Channel Short Text Classification With Fused Enhanced Features
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The present paper proposes a double-channel short text classification model with fused enhanced features to tackle the issues of feature sparsity, incomplete feature extraction, and important information loss in short text classification tasks. Specifically, Bert and CNN are employed to extract the global and local features of short text, respectively. Moreover, an attention mechanism is incorporated to enhance channel features and mitigate the problem of feature sparsity in short text. To prevent the loss of important information, the SoftPool pooling mechanism is adopted instead of the traditional average pooling. Then, the global and local features are fused interactively to address the issue of incomplete feature extraction. Finally, the Softmax classifier is utilized to obtain the final results for short text classification. The experimental results indicate that the model proposed in this study achieved optimal classification performance across three short-text datasets.

articleTitle: A Longitudinal Control Method for UAV Carrier Landing Based on Deep Q-Network Method
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper focused on the issues of strong ground effects and ship wake interference et al faced by high aspect ratio unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) during carrier landing. A network was established using the Deep Q-Network (DQN) algorithm to intelligently optimize the longitudinal control parameters of UAV. This method could improve the accuracy of UAV carrier landing control and reduce the longitudinal error of carrier landing. Using the mature inner and outer loop series PID control law in industrial applications as the initial control method, this method applied the training results of the DQN algorithm for parameter optimization. In addition, the DQN algorithm was optimized during use. By establishing a simulation model and conducting longitudinal carrier landing process simulation experiments, it is shown that compared with the typical PID control law method with internal and external loops connected in series, the proposed UAV carrier landing longitudinal control system optimized based on DQN method has significantly improved carrier landing accuracy and stability of carrier landing longitudinal error under different environment disturbances.

articleTitle: Cultivation Model of Mechanical Students Based on Integration Between Industry and Education
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Deepening the integration of industry and education is an important way to realize the deep integration of education and industry and enhance students' ability of practice and innovation. With the development of computer and information technology, the training mode of college talents has also undergone great changes. Aiming at the problem of poor innovation ability of mechanical students, the training mode of mechanical talents based on computer and information technology is put forward. Besides, the reform and development trend of talents training for the integration of production and education from three aspects is proposed. Project-based teaching using information technology is an important way to improve students' practical ability. This paper gives a design example of a crawling robot with computer control technology. The students' innovation ability is improved through the application cases of informatization. The reform ideas of talent training are given from two aspects, and the ways to improve innovation ability are given from five aspects. The research results will open a new way of thinking of university and enterprise cooperation in running schools based on new information technology.

articleTitle: Improve speech enhancement with Wave-USE-Net
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: At present, most deep learning speech enhancement models rely on spectrograms, and phase estimation is needed to restore the speech signal from spectrograms. In this paper, a speech enhancement model called Wave-USE-Net is proposed, which combines Squeeze-and-Excitation Networks(SENet) and Wave-U-Net. On the basis of Wave-U-Net directly estimating the waveform of the enhanced speech signal end-to-end, the SE block is used to suppress redundant features and effectively recover the enhanced speech signal. The experimental results show that compared with the baseline Wave-U-Net model, the proposed Wave-USE-Net model improves PESQ, CSIG, CBAK, COVL and SSNR by 7.5%,7.1%,1.2%,8.5% and 1.1% respectively on the VCTK dataset. The enhancement effect of the proposed model is better than that of other speech enhancement models based on Wave-U-Net, and the enhanced speech signal is closer to clean speech.

articleTitle: Research on Recommendation of Flipped Classroom Preview Resources Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Knowledge graph is a tool for representing knowledge using graph models. This article proposes a knowledge graph based framework for recommending pre class preview resources in flipped classrooms. This framework constructs a flipped classroom pre class preview process consisting of three main teaching activities: thematic knowledge point analysis, pre class preview homework assignment, and pre class preview learning evaluation. On this basis, this article proposes the construction methods of subject knowledge graph, extended knowledge graph, thematic knowledge graph, and personalized pre class preview knowledge graph. Based on the analysis of student learning profile data, determine the recommended ranking of pre class preview resources for each student. By recommending pre class preview resources, the learning efficiency of flipped classroom courses can be improved.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Recommender Systems Research Progress: A Bibliometric Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Deep Learning-Based Recommender Systems (DLRS) represent a prominent research area in the academic community. This paper aims to conduct a bibliometric and visualization analysis using the VOSviewer software, based on 1,435 DLRS-related publications retrieved from the Web of Science database. By analyzing the existing literature, this study investigates the quantity of DLRS papers, their research origins, affiliated institutions, and notable authors. The findings reveal a substantial and rapid growth trend in DLRS publications since 2016. Co-occurrence analysis uncovers five major research directions within this field: deep recommender systems, collaborative prediction models, neural network personalization, attention-based models in recommendation, and deep learning for recommender systems. Finally, this paper provides relevant recommendations for future research and practical applications of DLRS, addressing both researchers and industry professionals.

articleTitle: A Study on Pre-Semester Scheduling Disruption Recovery in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The expansion of higher education has brought scheduling disruptions to the forefront for universities and colleges. In contrast to previous studies focused solely on minimizing disruptions, this research introduces an optimization model that minimizes disruptions while maximizing teacher and student satisfaction. To effectively address this model, a reinforcement learning-enhanced genetic algorithm is employed to enhance optimization capabilities. Simulation experiments reveal that the approach proposed in this study generates scheduling solutions that significantly enhance student satisfaction, thereby improving efficiency and satisfaction during scheduling disruption recovery. This study not only formulates an optimization model but also refines a genetic algorithm, including encoding methods, initial population generation, and fitness function design. Additionally, a solution algorithm is developed and validated through simulations, offering fresh insights into enhancing the quality of class scheduling disruption recovery.

articleTitle: Development of a Micro-Target Detection Algorithm Based on Refactored SPPCSPC and Enhanced YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Addressing the challenges of small target feature loss in image detection, susceptibility to background noise interference, and difficulties in localization, this paper presents enhancements to the YOLOv7 target detection model. Initially, the first CBS layer is pruned, and the Backbone's SPPCSPC module incorporates the self-attention mechanism while shrinking the pooling kernel. This modification aims to reduce parameter count, redirecting the model's focus towards dense small-target regions. Subsequently, the self-attention mechanism is integrated into the neck network to adaptively select crucial information from inputs, thereby enhancing the model's performance amidst complex and variable backgrounds. Lastly, the SCIoU loss function is introduced as a replacement for CIoU, effectively reducing the total degrees of freedom in loss and enhancing the accuracy of loss calculations. Experimental results on the VisDrone2019 dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of the improved YOLOv7 small target detection algorithm, showcasing significant improvements in detection accuracy compared to various mainstream algorithms. This enhancement successfully meets the accuracy requirements for small target detection.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Chinese Online Course Reviews by Combining Prompt Learning and Contrastive Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The study of sentiment analysis of Chinese online course reviews can provide an in-depth understanding of students' learning attitudes and needs, optimize the teaching mode, and thereby improve the quality of teaching. To this end, this research proposes a sentiment analysis method for Chinese online course reviews, which combines prompt learning and contrast learning. First, a question and answer prompt template for the large-scale language model ELECTRA is constructed to guide ELECTRA to learn the semantic information contained in the Chinese online course review text. Then, contrastive learning is used to further enhance the data samples and learn feature representations. Finally, the feature representation trained by contrastive learning is input into the sparse Softmax function to perform sentiment polarity classification of Chinese online course reviews. The experimental results on real Chinese online course data sets show that the macro F1 value of the proposed model reaches more than 85% on the three data sets.

articleTitle: An Evaluation Research of Topic Extraction Results Based on External Metadata
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the increasing scale of literature publication and the rapid growth in the number of publications, topic extraction methods have also made great progress, yet the extent to which the topic extraction results reflect the true subject structure of the scientific literature remains an open question. In the development of topic extraction, the validity of topic extraction results has been an issue of concern to scholars. This paper contributes to validating the topic extraction method by using an external validation method to evaluate the topic extraction results. Considering that each piece of literature may involve more than one research topic, this thesis completes topic extraction using four overlapping community detection algorithms, COPRA, DEMON, SLPA, and GCE, based on direct citation network construction. The topic extraction results were then investigated for validation with the help of external metadata as the validation dataset.

articleTitle: Building a Future-Oriented Educational Ecosystem in Hainan Province: Integration and Innovation with Big Data in Grade Education
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In response to the escalating demand for skilled professionals, Hainan Province grapples with a scarcity in the talent market. Despite the abundance of available talent, the prevailing issue lies in the misalignment of individual Grade with the surging quantity. Consequently, establishing a visual evaluation system be arising for gauge the Grade of personnel training in higher education, addressing the practical need. Recognizing the limitations of existing evaluation methods, particularly, the ambiguity in magnitude relationships among educational pointers, this ariticle introduces a big data analysis model for a thorough assessment of teaching evaluation pointers, imparting a layer of scientific significanceness. Various systems within the directory framework serve as analysis objects, and the first-level magnitude relationships are normalized to ensure a more rational distribution of magnitudes. Though the bigly data analysis is applying, the teaching Grade evaluation system attains greaterer reasonableness and more scientific groundation. The ariticle emphasizes the design and construction of a Grade directory system tailored to the higher education landscape of Hainan Province. Leveraging big data analysis, the magnitude relationships of diverse educational pointers are meticulously scrutinized, leading to the identification of four primary pointers. Subsequently, the magnitude relationships of secondary pointers are analyzed, culminating in the establishment of overall magnitude relationships for all pointers. The findings indicate that the magnitude relationships for the four main directoryes are 0.3285, 0.1973, 0.2967, and 0.1755, providing the foundational framework for the education Grade evaluation model. This approach seamlessly integrates with the unique context of Hainan Province, offering a more tailored and effective assessment of talent development in the region.

articleTitle: Confidential Computation of Corresponding Elements of Set Intersection
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Secure multi-party computing is one of the most concerned fields in international cryptography. Besides, the problem of the sum of corresponding elements in the intersection of confidential computing sets is relatively new and has wide application scenarios. By using the addition homomorphism of the Lifted ElGamal threshold cryptosystem, this paper solves two problems related to the corresponding elements of the set intersection, namely, the sum of the associated values of the set intersection elements and the secret judgment of the relationship with the threshold. In the case of known data range, the corresponding secret calculation scheme is designed, in the process of calculation, the correlation value of the intersection elements of the set will not be disclosed, and only the final result is obtained. At the same time, the Lifted ElGamal threshold cryptosystem is used in this paper to resist collusive attacks.

articleTitle: An Evaluation Method for Teachers Based on the Quantitative Fuzzy Decision Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Admittedly, it is of paramount guiding significance to construct a scientific comprehensive evaluation system for university teachers' teaching performance to promote the overall improvement of university teaching quality. Despite the continuous emergence of evaluation models for teachers' performance, they are typically beset with two significant challenges, one of which lies in their limited ability to describe the expression degree of prior knowledge based on the importance degree of features and to optimize the fuzzification process quantitatively. The other challenge can be summarized as the failure of consequent parameters of fuzzy rules in executing the solution process conveniently and adaptively, as well as the adverse influence of redundant information in fuzzy rules on the model's prediction results. To tackle the foregoing challenges, this paper proposes a new fuzzy classification strategy to determine the corresponding important factors by leveraging the importance of critical features selected based on information gain. This is further employed to realize quantitative optimization of the features' membership degree, thereby improving the overall fuzzification process. On the other hand, this paper proposes a novel method for obtaining the consequent parameters, which can not only optimize the redundant expression in fuzzy rules by using multiple correlation coefficients but also flexibly make the predicted output infinitely close to the true value, thus improving the generalization performance of the model and enhancing its linguistic interpretability. Also, this aligns with the explainable artificial intelligence (XAI), a current research hotspot. The experimental results demonstrate that the model proposed in this paper exhibits excellent decision-making ability, generalization performance, and linguistic interpretability on the adopted teacher performance evaluation datasets.

articleTitle: Research on the Mechanism of the Impact of Blended Learning on Learning Engagement
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the continuous development of information technology, higher education is also undergoing constant reforms and innovations. With the continuous improvement of Internet technology, blended learning has become the norm in universities. Learning engagement is not only an important indicator for measuring the quality of students' learning process, but also a crucial factor affecting their learning outcomes. Based on the compilation of existing factors influencing learning engagement, this study constructs a hypothetical model of factors influencing learning engagement from dimensions such as “self-regulated learning ability,” “academic self-efficacy,” and “teaching presence.” Through empirical research, it explores the factors influencing learning engagement and their mechanisms among university students. Taking current university students as the research subjects, this study utilized questionnaire surveys and conducted structural equation analysis using SPSS. The results show that teaching presence has a positive impact on academic self-efficacy. Teaching presence has a positive impact on learning engagement. Academic self-efficacy has a positive impact on learning engagement. Self-regulation positively moderates the impact of academic self-efficacy on learning engagement. Selfregulation negatively moderates the impact of teaching presence on learning engagement. Academic self-efficacy plays an intermediary role in the impact of teaching presence on learning engagement. Based on these findings, strategies and suggestions for enhancing learning engagement in blended learning are proposed.

articleTitle: Research on the Hotspots and Frontiers of Online Learning Engagement Based on Scientific Knowledge Map
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Learning engagement is a critical factor for determining learners' learning performance in online learning. This study employs CiteSpace, an information software, to research the literature co-citation, keyword co-occurrence, keyword cluster and burst detection on the online learning engagement research literature in the core collection of Web of Science from 2012 to 2022. The results show that “student engagement”, “online learning”, “learning engagement”, “education”, “high education”, “performance”, “motivation”, and “achievement” represent the key issues of online learning engagement research. The research hotspots in the field of online learning engagement have mainly focused on the following three aspects: learning engagement in massive open online courses, student engagement of online courses, and the learning engagement of blended learning. Blended learning is a wellwatched research frontier in the field of online learning engagement, and a gamified online learning environment, cyberslacking and chatbot represent the future research trend of online learning engagement research.

articleTitle: Prediction of Learning Effectiveness Assessment and Experience Evaluation of Panoramic VR Video in Hands-On Education and Design of its Application
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The widespread use of virtual reality (VR) technology is transforming the field of education and training. This study explores the potential of VR in education, with a special focus on immersion, presence and immersion, and the critical role of first-person perspective when interaction is absent and viewing position is fixed. The experimental results show that VR can improve students' concentration and enthusiasm for learning, and is crucial for developing hands-on skills and knowledge construction. In addition, we propose a model based on Spearman's correlation analysis to evaluate the influencing factors of VR experience. In order to improve the quality of teaching and learning, this study introduces a predictive model for evaluating VR experience based on the mechanism of multi-head attention, and the performance effect of the proposed model is verified by the collected experimental data. This study provides strong support for further utilizing VR to improve education. Finally, this study proposes the design and application scenarios of an immersive content recording device for educational content based on the research, to build and test functional prototypes, and to try new ideas for the production and tradition of VR educational content.

articleTitle: Research on Uav Training System
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the rapid transformation of uav technology and the rapid updating and iteration of uav models, the demand for uav operators in various industries is increasing, and standard requirements are also constantly improving. Various institutions are also exploring and improving methods and means for uav training. Under the new situation and requirements, how to fully utilize information technology to reasonably allocate teaching and training resources and improve the level of uav training has become the most urgent problem currently faced. This article combines the characteristics of uav control and the current status of uav training, combined with the advantages of information training, to analyze and construct a uav training system, laying a good foundation for cultivating uav operators with high standards and effectively improving the level of uav training.

articleTitle: A Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithm Based on Indicator and Performing Local Searches
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The indicator-based multi-objective optimization evolutionary algorithm has gained significant attention for its strong performance across various optimization problems. We draw on the advantages and try to make improvements in the environmental selection process based on different selection criteria. From this, we developed a distinctive multi-objective evolutionary algorithm that based on indicator and performing local searches, namely INLS. The INLS algorithm includes a novel selection mechanism that does not rely on weight vectors, which employs a strategy choosing solutions with relatively poor convergence but good diversity to perturb the decision variables of the selected solutions, aiming to explore and discover solutions that demonstrate enhanced convergence and diversity characteristics. The experimental results obtained from conducting tests on the ZDT and DTLZ test suites provide clear evidence of the remarkable performance exhibited by the proposed INLS in comparison to various other well-known MOEAs. These results serve to underscore the competitiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Application of 3D Simulation Technology in Highaltitude Safety Accidents
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the increasingly developed national economy, the development of electricity is crucial, which extends the importance of safety training for high-altitude power operators. At present, there are many problems with the training mode for power high-altitude operators in China. The author combines practical projects to study the application of 3D simulation technology in power high-altitude operation safety training. The main research focuses on how to simulate real scenes through materials, textures. Arode renderers and bone animations in Maya software, in order to innovate the training methods for power highaltitude operators, and summarize the advantages of 3D virtual simulation animation compared to traditional training methods. Produce a 3D virtual simulation animation of the “Accident Case of Incorrect Use of Safety Belts in High Altitude Work”, which can be used as a promotional training video for the power industry and as a reference for other safety training promotional videos.

articleTitle: Exploration and Practice of Applying Large Language Models in Home Education Guidance
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Currently, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in general question answering, text generation, and scientific reasoning, profoundly influencing the development of natural language question answering. In this context, this study proposes a new model that combines a large language model with family education guidance, and constructs a personalized guidance question-and-answer system for family education. To enhance the professionalism and accuracy of the model in family education guidance question answering, we autonomously built a knowledge base for family education guidance and a dataset for family education guidance dialogues. Simultaneously, a prefix text filtering network was introduced, coupled with memory storage techniques, effectively preventing hallucination issues. Finally, experiments were conducted through expert evaluation and performance assessment, confirming the system's professionalism and effectiveness in family education guidance. In comparison to general language models like ChatGPT, this system has achieved significant results in providing guidance on family education and answering questions related to professional family education knowledge.
